# Anguilla Massage by Tranquilitas

Luxury mobile massage service across Anguilla.

Canonical site: https://anguilla.caribspa.org/

Primary services: Swedish Massage, Deep Tissue Massage, Couples Massage, Beach Massage, Villa Massage, Hotel / Resort Massage, Yacht Massage and Mobile Massage.

Current Anguilla pricing from the Tranquilitas Caribbean rate sheet: Swedish $185 for 60 min / $225 for 90 min; Deep Tissue $205 / $260; Couples $375 / $555; Beach Massage $205 / $260.

Service areas: Meads Bay, Shoal Bay, Rendezvous Bay, Sandy Ground, The Valley and surrounding areas.

Booking requests are pending until therapist availability and access are confirmed.
